page.overview:
Who is Hornbuckle?

One of Jade's hints was "Hornbuckle Who?". This was a reference to someone named Leanne Hornbuckle who appeared in the credits for Mortal Kombat II. However, fans interpreted this as the name of the character in the background. The character in the background of the Pit II stage was later added to Blaze's storyline, presumed to be one of the "holy men" who captured and forced him to guard Onaga's egg. Hornbuckle appears in Shaolin Monks during the fifth quest given by Smoke. The Pit II area shows Hornbuckle and Blaze sparring in the background.

Due to Hornbuckle's outfit being a palette swap of Liu Kang's it is believed that he is related to him; in fact, Ed Boon once referred to the character as Liu Kang.
